test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Murali is 14th from the right-end in a row of 40 students. What is his position from the left-end?
solution:
Murali is 14th from the right end in a row of 40 boys.

His position from the left end = (40 - 14) + 1

= 27.

Hence, Murali will be "27th" from the left end.
